meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 给选定的 NanoClaw agent 装上 Dial 容器工具：它能在沙箱内发短信、打 AI 语音电话、接收验证码，费用记在 Dial 账户上。未被选中的 agent 尝试调用会被网关拦截（403 blocked_by_policy）。
howto.when: 从 NanoClaw 仓库的主机上运行，不能在聊天里让 agent 自己装。当你想让 agent 能发短信、打电话等，但不想把 Dial 配成消息渠道时使用；需要已装 OneCLI，否则先运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 重新运行 add-dial-tool，改成只让 ag-abc 能用 Dial
say.note: 重复运行即可改变授权名单

say.text: 运行 add-dial-tool 装上工具，但所有 agent 都先不开放
say.note: 装好工具，全部 agent 暂时拦截

howto.what_en: Gives chosen NanoClaw agents Dial as a container tool: they can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes inside the sandbox, billed to the Dial account. Agents not chosen get blocked at the gateway (403 blocked_by_policy).
howto.when_en: Run it from the NanoClaw repo on the host, not from a chat with an agent. Use when you want agents to text, call, etc., without wiring Dial as a messaging channel; needs OneCLI installed first.

say_en.text: Run add-dial-tool so agent ag-xxxx can use Dial
say_en.note: It first asks which agents may use it

say_en.text: Re-run add-dial-tool to allow Dial only for ag-abc
Run add-dial-tool to install it, but block all agents for now
